[[File:Champion_Valkorion.jpg|thumb|220px|Valkorion was a Champion of ancient Zakuul.]]
'''Champion''' was the title held by one of the three [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] who led the nomadic tribes of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]] before [[Tenebrae|Valkorion's]] arrival and the formation of the [[Eternal Empire]]. Each tribe was led by a [[Matriarch (Zakuul)|Matriarch]], Champion, and [[High Shaman]], and after he united the tribes, Valkorion repurposed the three roles as the [[Knights of Zakuul]], an order of Force-sensitive warriors.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|Knights of Zakuul}}</ref>
